selection_score: mean empirical query MSE, equal weight for familiar and calibration-only pairs
target_prior_only_controls: Every selected family is evaluated both with the baseline 32+32 policy and its calibrated numerical/allocation policy, on the same target functions and random streams. This separates prior changes from solver changes.
note: Every search uses 65536 optimizer updates on individual models, batch64. Refit slots rotate over the best distinct masks, never consulting population risk or true support. Model/prior confirmation, numerical tuning and allocation use only confirmation functions; resulting optimism is assessed on fresh target functions.
